title: [Master]-Applying entries across posting groups (Allow Multiple Posting Groups) posts the G/L entries that move the amount between receivables accounts with ACY = 0
summary: When entries are applied across different posting groups (Allow Multiple Posting Groups), the G/L entries that move the amount between receivables accounts were posted with an additional-currency amount (ACY) of zero. The posting logic now handles ACY for these entries, and tests cover the case.
key_points: Fixes G/L entries between receivables accounts being posted with ACY = 0 when applying across posting groups
Changes Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in the W1 layer and 10 country layers, plus the CZ Gen.Jnl. Post Line Handler
Extends the ERM Multiple Posting Groups tests in several layers and adjusts the apply/unapply customer tests
